title: AI DevSecOps Vulnerability Remediation — 21 Days to 3 Days
author: AikiField
exact_source_text: How to reduce vulnerability remediation time from 21 days to 3 days using AI tooling. The bottleneck isn't finding vulnerabilities — it's the manual triage and escalation workflow. AI-assisted DevSecOps with Aikido.dev integration cuts remediation from 165 days to 21 days, and with AI-assisted remediation prompts, further down to 3 days. Reducing vulnerability remediation from 21 days to 3 days requires three changes: (1) integrate a vulnerability management platform like Aikido.dev into your CI/CD pipeline for continuous scanning at commit time, (2) implement AI-assisted triage that automatically prioritizes vulnerabilities by exploitability and business impact, and (3) use AI-assisted remediation workflows that generate fix prompts and validate patches. The engineer validates and ships — the AI handles the assessment bottleneck. 165 days Manual triage baseline before rearchitecture. 21 days After workflow rearchitecture with Aikido.dev integration. 3 days With AI-assisted remediation prompts and automated routing.
